UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered PERQ user profile stored in the users collection keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

name.description: Full name of the registered user.

email.description: Normalized email address of the authenticated user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was first created.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent successful sign-in.

LoginActivity.title: LoginActivity
LoginActivity.description: Audit record written to the loginActivity collection on every successful user sign-in.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the user who signed in.

email.description: Email address of the user who signed in.

loginAt.description: Server timestamp when the sign-in event occurred.

/users/{uid}.description: Stores registered PERQ user profiles keyed by Firebase Authentication UID.

/loginActivity/{activityId}.description: Stores immutable login activity events for authenticated PERQ users.
